data.long_meaning: The name Rampal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rama' (Rise) and 'Pal' (lotus). The name Rampal carries the meaning “Rise of the lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit.
